nodes.evidence: The plan is the load-bearing interface between `/afk:to-subtasks` (emitter) and `/afk:execute` (parser + progress writer). Entirely on disk: `plan/PLAN.md` (index — solution map, seam register, progress tracker) + one `plan/NNNN-slug.md` contract per subtask, sibling to `PRD.md`/`SDD.md`. A subtask's **id** is its filename stem (`NNNN-slug`); no Jira keys in the plan. Adding/renaming/changing a section → update **both** `skills/afk/to-subtasks/SKILL.md` ("Subtask contract" emitter) and `skills/afk/execute/SKILL.md` (Step 1 parser) in the same commit — same repo so this lockstep is enforced by one commit. Likewise the outcome status set (now including `adversary_fail`): broadening it → update the status list in `/afk:execute` Step 13 and any skill referencing a status by name. Autopilot's park handling is deliberately status-agnostic — its step 4 parks on anything that is not a recognised success — so a new status needs no edit there, and its absence from `skills/afk/autopilot/SKILL.md` is not drift. Smoke gate has two shapes — full (`## Feature smoke gate`) and minimal (`## Feature smoke gate (minimal)`) — same three-way lockstep: `to-verification-plan` emitter (full only), `to-subtasks` seeder (both, incl. minimal-gate template in its SMOKE-GATE.md), `smoke-test` reader (both). Independent review gate is its own lockstep set: `/afk:execute` Step 10 and `/afk:preflight` PF-3 both invoke `/afk:review` (slice / `--feature`) inside the settle loop (`skills/afk/review/SETTLEMENT.md` — round structure, fix-or-dispute, dispute adjudication, ledger-only and stalemate termination, scope escalation, the park-report contract, referee information diet) and route findings by `class` — change `/afk:review`'s verdict set, `class` enum, concern list, or the settle-loop protocol → update both gates' routing (and the PF-3 `Cycle`-cell cap copy in `skills/afk/to-subtasks/PLAN-TEMPLATE.md`) in the same commit. The `product-debt` class is its own lockstep set: the class + its homing rule are owned by `/afk:review` ("Product-debt homes"), the `## Known debt` entry shape by `/afk:claude-md`, the filter by `SETTLEMENT.md` step 2, and the enforcement by `/afk:preflight` PF-4d (+ its `PLAN-TEMPLATE.md` row), and the reviewer-facing prohibition by `skills/afk/review/checklists/PRECEDENCE.md` (rule 6) — change any → all six in the same commit. The review **gate policy** (`lean`/`full`) is its own lockstep set: split + resolution owned by `/afk:review` "Gate policy" ↔ emitters `skills/afk/to-subtasks/SUBTASK-CONTRACT.md` (`## Review`) + `PLAN-TEMPLATE.md` (`Review policy:` header) ↔ the deferral declarations in `/afk:execute` Step 10 and `/afk:preflight` PF-3 (rule mechanics: `skills/afk/review/SETTLEMENT.md` "Deferral rule") ↔ the deferrable-concern copy in `validate_plan.py` (h) — change any → all in the same commit. The adversarial gate is its own pair: change `/afk:adversary`'s verdict set or finding classes → update `/afk:execute` Step 10.5's gate logic in the same commit. A concern add/rename/removal also touches its `skills/afk/review/checklists/{concern}.md` and (design-level) the trigger table in review's SKILL.md; the caller-side outcome files (`plan/review/*.outcomes.json`) and `/afk:retro`'s criterion-yield mining share the findings-JSON `criterion`/`id` shape — widen it → touch execute Step 10, preflight PF-3, and retro's mining table in the same commit. The human-locked set is a four-file lockstep: aspects + contract grades + signing protocol owned by `skills/afk/grill-solution/HUMAN-SIGNOFF.md`, recorded through the signoff-row grammar in `skills/afk/grill-requirements/GRILL-LOG-FORMAT.md`, carried into `skills/afk/to-sdd/SDD-TEMPLATE.md` (§0 register + each aspect's section) and enforced by `/afk:to-sdd`'s sign-off gate — change the set or a grade → all four in the same commit. The round dossier is its own lockstep set: the interaction model — item classes, the decide rule, evidence grades, the decided-card contract, dossier sections, audit controls, steering and the escape, the merge rule — is owned by `skills/afk/grill-requirements/ROUND.md`, the grammar its response is composed in by `LAVISH-KIT.md` (plugin root), the card fields the renderer enforces by `scripts/lavish/schema.py`, and the checkpoint tail by `skills/afk/grill-requirements/GRILL-LOG-FORMAT.md` — change a class, a field, a grade or the response grammar → all four in the same commit, and re-read every grill that points at ROUND.md for a restatement that has gone stale.
